before_observations: The supplied WebGL build displayed the tutorial background but omitted the player and map tiles.
The inactive pressed ControlButton background became visible after its texture loaded, appearing offset from the normal background.
Pending sprites could be rejected by SpriteBatchNode before their texture finished loading.
after_observations: Player and map geometry rendered in WebGL; texture coordinates were finite and nonzero for the tested maps.
Normal and highlighted button backgrounds remained mutually exclusive, including across deferred loads.
Late frame/texture callbacks no longer replaced current Sprite and Scale9Sprite state.
Canvas converted rotated packed frames both on deferred load and on an immediate texture-cache hit.
limitations: Not tested on a physical webOS television or its GPU driver.
ares-package was unavailable; no IPK was built or installed.
The offline adapter did not serve CSS font requests; browser font-loading warnings occurred. These are separate from the game window-error arrays in this report.
Screenshots were taken at different animation times, not as a pixel-identical visual comparison.
Only tutorial/reentry/map100 scenarios and the listed synthetic regression checks were tested; not a full game playthrough.
Texture/audio byte counts are cache estimates, not process RSS, peak decode memory, GPU memory, or a TV performance measurement.
Previous 1.0.8 reports and changes.patch remain historical records, not results of this verification.
